actions.add_subscriber.description: Add an email address to an audience, creating the contact if needed.
actions.add_subscriber.props.custom_fiel: Replaces all of the contact's custom fields, e.g. company: Acme.
actions.add_subscriber_by_id.description: Add an email address to an audience given by ID or name.
actions.add_subscriber_by_id.props.audie: The audience ID (aud_…) or its exact name. Use List Audiences to find it.
actions.add_subscriber_by_id.props.custo: Replaces all of the contact's custom fields, e.g. company: Acme.
actions.add_suppression.description: Stop Emailit from sending to an address, permanently or until a date.
actions.add_suppression.props.keep_until: Optional expiry. Leave empty for a permanent suppression.
actions.add_suppression.props.reason.des: Free-text note, e.g. "Asked to stop receiving invoices".
actions.add_suppression.props.type.descr: Only "recipient" blocks API and SMTP sends; campaigns skip every type.
actions.cancel_email.description: Cancel an email that is scheduled, queued or waiting to retry.
actions.cancel_email.props.email_id.desc: The Emailit email ID, e.g. em_4KYof1ZzXndZE2VPi0DgULiekG8 (from a Send Email step or Find Emails).
actions.create_or_update_contact.descrip: Create a contact, or update the existing contact with the same email.
actions.create_or_update_contact.props.a: Audiences to subscribe the contact to. Existing memberships are kept.
actions.create_or_update_contact.props.c: Replaces all custom fields of an existing contact. Leave empty to keep.
actions.create_or_update_contact_by_id.d: Create or update a contact, adding it to audiences given by ID.
Create or Update Contact (by Audience ID)
actions.create_or_update_contact_by_id.p: Audience IDs (aud_…) to subscribe the contact to.
Replaces all custom fields of an existing contact. Leave empty to keep.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.find_contact.description: Look up a contact by email address or contact ID.
actions.forward_email.description: Send a copy of a sent email to new recipients.
actions.forward_email.props.comment.desc: Plain-text note above the forwarded message (only with the header option).
actions.forward_email.props.email_id.des: ID of the outgoing email to forward.
actions.forward_email.props.from.descrip: Optional. Defaults to the original sender.
actions.forward_email.props.idempotency_: Optional. A unique value (letters, digits, - and _; up to 256) such as an order ID. If this step runs again with the same key within 24 hours, Emailit returns the first result instead of sending again.
actions.forward_email.props.include_head: Adds the original sender, date and subject above the content, with your note.
actions.forward_email.props.subject.desc: Optional. Defaults to the original subject.
actions.get_domain.description: Get a sending domain with its verification status and the DNS records to publish.
actions.get_domain_by_id.description: Get a sending domain by ID or name.
actions.get_domain_by_id.props.domain.de: Domain ID (dom_…) or domain name, e.g. acme.com.
actions.get_email.description: Get one sent or received email with its status, headers, body and attachment list.
actions.get_email.props.email_id.descrip: The Emailit email ID, e.g. em_4KYof1ZzXndZE2VPi0DgULiekG8 (from a Send Email step or Find Emails).
actions.list_audiences.description: List the audiences (subscriber lists) of the workspace.
actions.list_audiences.props.page.descri: Page to return, starting at 1. Use it when the previous result had Has More Pages = true.
actions.list_domains.description: List the sending domains of the workspace with their verification status.
actions.list_domains.props.page.descript: Page to return, starting at 1. Use it when the previous result had Has More Pages = true.
actions.list_emails.description: Search sent or received emails, newest first (last 14 days unless you set dates).
actions.list_emails.props.page.descripti: Page to return, starting at 1. Use it when the previous result had Has More Pages = true.
actions.list_templates.description: List the published email templates of the workspace.
actions.list_templates.props.name.descri: Part of the template name or alias.
actions.list_templates.props.page.descri: Page to return, starting at 1. Use it when the previous result had Has More Pages = true.
actions.remove_subscriber.description: Delete someone's membership in an audience. The contact is kept.
actions.remove_subscriber_by_id.descript: Remove a subscriber from an audience given by ID or name.
actions.remove_subscriber_by_id.props.au: The audience ID (aud_…) or its exact name. Use List Audiences to find it.
actions.remove_suppression.description: Remove a suppression so Emailit can send to the address again.
actions.retry_email.description: Send a bounced, failed, suppressed or held email again as a new email.
actions.retry_email.props.email_id.descr: ID of the bounced, failed, suppressed or held email.
actions.send_email.description: Send an email to one or more recipients via Emailit.
actions.send_email.props.attachment_file: Optional. A file from a previous step to attach.
actions.send_email.props.attachments.des: Optional. Files Emailit downloads when sending (public http/https URL, max 25 MB, no redirects).
actions.send_email.props.bcc.description: Send a hidden copy to these addresses. Other recipients won't see them. Up to 50.
actions.send_email.props.cc.description: Send a visible copy to these addresses. Up to 50.
actions.send_email.props.content.descrip: The message body. Use Plain Text for simple messages or HTML for rich formatting. Required unless you send a template.
actions.send_email.props.from_email.desc: Email address to send from. It must be on a verified sending domain of your Emailit workspace.
actions.send_email.props.from_name.descr: Name recipients will see in their inbox, e.g. "Acme Support". If left blank, only the email address is shown.
actions.send_email.props.headers.descrip: Add custom email headers as key-value pairs, e.g. X-Campaign-ID: welcome. Line breaks are not allowed.
actions.send_email.props.idempotency_key: Optional. A unique value (letters, digits, - and _; up to 256) such as an order ID. If this step runs again with the same key within 24 hours, Emailit returns the first result instead of sending again.
actions.send_email.props.meta.descriptio: Optional. Your own key-value data stored with the email and sent back in webhooks, e.g. order_id: 1042.
actions.send_email.props.plain_text.desc: Optional, for HTML emails: a plain-text version sent alongside the HTML. Recommended for deliverability.
actions.send_email.props.reply_to.descri: Where replies go. Defaults to the sender email if left blank. Separate several addresses with commas.
actions.send_email.props.scheduled_at.de: Optional. Schedule the email for later (ISO 8601 with time zone). Leave empty to send now.
actions.send_email.props.subject.descrip: The subject line shown in the recipient's inbox. Required unless you send a template.
actions.send_email.props.template.descri: Optional. A template ID (tem_…) or alias. Subject and body in this step override the template's.
actions.send_email.props.to.description: Recipient email addresses, e.g. ada@example.com or Ada Lovelace <ada@example.com>. Up to 50 here, and up to 50 each in CC and BCC.
actions.send_email.props.tracking.descri: Uses the sending domain's setting by default. Tracking only works when the domain's tracking CNAME is verified.
actions.send_email.props.variables.descr: Optional. Values for {{placeholders}} in the subject and body, e.g. {"first_name": "Ada"}.
actions.send_email_ai.description: Send an email through Emailit and return the created email.
actions.send_email_ai.props.from_email.d: Address on a verified sending domain of the workspace.
actions.send_email_ai.props.idempotency_: Optional. A unique value (letters, digits, - and _; up to 256) such as an order ID. If this step runs again with the same key within 24 hours, Emailit returns the first result instead of sending again.
actions.send_email_ai.props.scheduled_at: ISO 8601 date-time with time zone, e.g. 2026-10-02T09:00:00Z. Empty sends now.
actions.update_scheduled_email.descripti: Change the send time of a scheduled email.
actions.update_scheduled_email.props.ema: ID of the scheduled email. For a send to several recipients, each recipient has its own ID.
actions.update_scheduled_email.props.sch: ISO 8601 with time zone; at least 3 minutes from now.
actions.update_subscriber.description: Subscribe or unsubscribe someone from an audience, or change their name.
actions.update_subscriber_by_id.descript: Update a subscriber of an audience given by ID or name.
actions.update_subscriber_by_id.props.au: The audience ID (aud_…) or its exact name. Use List Audiences to find it.
actions.verify_domain.description: Re-check a sending domain's DNS records now and update its verification status.
actions.verify_domain_by_id.description: Re-check a sending domain given by ID or name.
actions.verify_email_address.description: Check whether an address is valid and safe to send to. Costs 5 credits per check.
auth.description: Get your API key from your [Emailit Workspace Settings](https://app.emailit.com/settings/api-keys). A **Full Access** key works with every action. A **Sending Only** key can send, reschedule, cancel, retry and forward emails, but not read emails or manage domains, audiences, contacts or suppressions.
